reason: I already go to my mums' group and a mums-and-bubs class, and that's where I actually turn up because people expect me there. I'd grab the free week, probably do two sessions on my own at home, and then it'd slide with two kids running around.
objection: Home programs don't stick for me. A private online group isn't the same as seeing the other mums in person, so I doubt I'd finish 8 weeks alone in the lounge room.
would_change_my_mind: If it ran alongside my weekly class, or the founding group met up in person now and then, so I had real people keeping me accountable.
